forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Andrew Neil,

Thank you for the suggestion.

The ‘PWR’ tag was removed, and the ‘Low Power’ tag was added. The ‘Power’ tag remains.

Regarding the post below, it is under review.

[Improvement: better tag searching when creating a post | Community](https://community.st.com/feedback-forum-118/improvement-better-tag-searching-when-creating-a-post-167007)

forum.content_text:
For questions relating to low-power modes.

I wanted just now for a recent post related to low-power modes, and the Tag search didn’t find anything.

But I’ve just seen that we do have `PWR` and `POWER` - so maybe this is just another case of improving the search?

<https://community.st.com/feedback-forum-118/improvement-better-tag-searching-when-creating-a-post-167007>
